label: Shopping Bag
depicts: Shopping bag with one rounded smile shaped inner cutout hanging below the top handle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a friendly shopping bag marked by the curved inner opening beneath the handle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain bag or the folded flap bag when the opening detail should not be the main distinguishing feature.

label: Shopping Bag
depicts: Shopping bag with a folded top flap or lid drawn across the opening above the smile shaped inner cutout
use_when: Use when the interface wants the bag to look more boxed in at the top with a visible flap over the opening.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain bag or the smile opening bag when the top edge should not look capped by a folded flap.

label: Shopping Cart
depicts: Wire shopping cart with a long rear handle and a rectangular basket and two small wheels under the base
use_when: Use when the interface wants the cart to read as a simple rectangular wire basket with an extended rear handle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the slanted cart variant when the basket front should angle downward and the handle should sit more compactly.

label: Shopping Cart
depicts: Shopping cart with a slanted front basket wall and compact handle and two small wheels under a shorter base
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tighter cart silhouette with a more angled basket front.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rectangular cart when the basket should look flatter and the rear handle should extend farther back.

label: Shuffle
depicts: Two crossing path arrows forming one X shape with both arrowheads pointing outward on the right side
use_when: Use when the interface wants shuffle to read as two paths crossing through each other before exiting rightward.
avoid_when: Do not use for the split path shuffle when the arrows should run in separate parallel lanes instead of crossing as an X.
